note: The bands the E-flite Extra 300 3D 1.3m plant has to land in, from docs/EXTRA-STAGE1.md, which derives each from E-flite's published figures, its photographs, APC's data for the prop's stand in and momentum theory (scripts/extra-derive.js prints the derived figures). E-flite publishes no bench or flight figure, so the performance bands are about derived figures built on an ESTIMATED motor and drag, and each says how wide and why. Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

e1_level_75.source: level speed at 75 percent throttle, derived 18.11 from the estimated thrust line and drag polar; 12 percent either way, the width of the estimate's two inputs, the prop's thrust (APC's 13 x 6.5E standing in for the wood 13 x 6) and cd0

e2_stall.source: sqrt(2W / rho S CLmax), derived 8.54 at E-flite's 40.9 g/dm^2 and the wing's CLmax at the stall's own Reynolds number, 1.7e5 on the chord: 0.898, from Timmer's measured NACA 0018 (0.988 at 1.5e5, 1.056 at 3e5) times Raymer's 0.9 for the wing (plant_wing.c stall_re, docs/EXTRA-STAGE1.md). Re-derived 2026-10-09 from 8.31 on the estimated 0.95. alphaStall is CLmax over the wing's own slope, 0.898 / 4.390. The Kadet's band in proportion, 0.94 to 1.14 of the formula, since the plant reads the stall at the blend's midpoint

e3_glide.source: L/D at 12 m/s, derived 7.12, 12 percent either way: a 3D aircraft's glide is short, its wing loading low and its drag high

e4_top.source: level speed at full throttle, derived 24.34, 10 percent either way

e5_roll.source: pb/2V at full aileron on the high rate, Clda throw_a / -Clp, derived 0.378 (497 deg/s at 15 m/s); 25 percent either way, the width the large deflection correction K' carries. The review's 'crazy fast roll rate', and faster than the full size 300L's 400 deg/s

e6_hover.source: hanging on the prop, the nose held up by the elevator and rudder in the slipstream, the height held by the throttle: the stick where the thrust meets the weight, sqrt(W / T_static), derived 0.6255; 5 percent either way, since at zero airspeed the plant's thrust is the table's duty squared exactly and nothing but the pilot's hold is in the way

e7_vertical.source: straight up at full throttle, the climb speed where the thrust meets the weight and the zero lift drag, derived 15.76; 10 percent either way. Only an aircraft whose thrust is over its weight has one

e8_torque_roll.source: hanging on the prop at the hover throttle with the ailerons let go: the prop's 0.255 N m of reaction (torque_arm W), less the swirl's roll, the root's (1 - SWIRL_KEEP) of it and the fin's, 0.40 of the torque by Selig's figure for a hover capable aerobat (AIAA 2010-7938, sec. B; SWIRL_KEEP 0.74, docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md), 0.152 N m net, against the air the turning wing sweeps through (rot_k roll, Hoerner's flat plate on every strip), steady at sqrt(Q / k), derived 178 deg/s, to the left; 25 percent either way. Before the swirl: 230 deg/s; at SWIRL_KEEP 0.5: 146

e9_aileron_hover.source: the same, with full right aileron: the aileron's inboard share in the slipstream, dp fa S b Clda throw_a, 0.362 N m, beats the net torque's 0.152, and the aircraft rolls right at sqrt((0.362 - 0.152) / k), derived 209 deg/s; 40 percent either way, since it is the difference of two estimates. Before the swirl: 149; at SWIRL_KEEP 0.5: 232

e10_zero_speed.source: hanging still on the prop, full up elevator and full right rudder from rest: the slipstream's dp on the surfaces' immersed shares, each saturating on a flat plate at its control's angle (hi_alpha), derived 38.86 rad/s^2 in pitch and 32.47 in yaw; 25 percent either way. With the prop stopped and nothing else changed the same sticks give under 5 percent of it: the authority is the wash's

e11_harrier.source: level at a body angle of attack of 40 deg, the throttle holding height: the stalled wing's plate lift and the thrust's vertical share against the weight, the thrust's forward share against the drag, derived 6.25 m/s at 0.603 throttle with the elevator at 66 percent of its throw, the stabiliser at its own angle and saturating as the plant takes it; the speed 20 percent and the throttle 15 percent either way, and the elevator short of full

e12_knife_edge.source: rolled to 90 deg at 15 m/s, height held on the rudder: the fuselage and fin lifting sideways at a sideslip, normal to the body, with the crossflow drag, and the thrust's share along the yawed axis, derived 34.3 deg of sideslip at 0.775 throttle with the rudder at 78 percent of its throw; the sideslip 25 percent and the throttle 15 percent either way, and the rudder short of full

e13_rest.source: the drawn model at rest, 6.7 deg nose up off E-flite's side photograph, the CG 0.2221 m up, 18.3 percent of the weight on the tailwheel; half a degree, 5 mm and 3.5 points either way

e14_takeoff.source: full throttle from standing, the tail up at 5 m/s and the nose to 8 deg at 10 m/s: liftoff at 10.0 m/s after 2.78 m (extra:derive); 40 percent short and 60 long, since the plant's roll has the gear's springs and the pilot's hands in it and the derivation has neither

e15_unmoved.source: every other aircraft's recorded flight hash in Node, the five inch's canonical replay among them, as main's module flies them without the Extra; the Extra adds a table and its own id, 29, and moves nothing else (docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md)

e16_cross_host.source: the Extra's recorded take off, hover, torque roll and flight, state trace hash, Node against headless Chrome
